name: subtitle-redaction-workbench
description: 字幕脱敏审校台：WebVTT 正则脱敏、优先级合并、逐条撤销预览与审计导出

scripts.build: npm run build -w @app/shared && npm run build -w @app/server && npm run build -w @app/client
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @app/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @app/shared" "npm run dev -w @app/server" "npm run dev -w @app/client"
